text:
- Back up to your own OneDrive, now on iPhone and iPad too, and choose which device's progress to use when they differ.
- New look: a new Recap Page wordmark on Home and a shorter Marvel Unlimited notice.
- New to Marvel comics? A new guide with starter picks and two optional Reading Lists.
- A clearer next step after you finish a Reading List.
- New reading lists: Siege, Realm of Kings, Fall of the Hulks, World War Hulks and Captain America (2025).
